zh.title: 新功能
items: 配色面板新增 **custom 自定义配色体系**，可调出专属主题，并提供实时代码预览效果。

zh.title: 优化
items: 工具调用展示压缩为极简单行，聊天界面更清爽。
Diff 视图的增删色块整行铺满、去掉行号列分隔，改动一目了然。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复 Claude（opus-4-8 等）**推理过程不可见**的问题，深度思考的思考摘要现在能正常展示。
修复思考强度**档位被降级**的问题：Anthropic / OpenAI 各档位（含 xhigh 超深度）现在完整显示，不再被压成四档。
多行输入时，输入框会**随内容自动增高**（到上限后内部滚动），不再把内容压在一行里。
为目标计划的探索子任务数量补上**安全上限**，防止异常情况下失控消耗资源。

en.title: What's New
items: Color panel adds a **custom palette system** for personal themes, with live code preview.

en.title: Improvements
items: Tool-call display is compressed to a minimal single line for a cleaner chat UI.
Diff view fills whole rows for add/remove blocks and drops the line-number column divider so changes stand out.

en.title: Fixes
items: Fixed invisible Claude (e.g. opus-4-8) reasoning summaries so deep-thinking content shows correctly.
Fixed thinking-level downgrades: Anthropic / OpenAI levels (including xhigh) now display fully instead of being collapsed to four tiers.
Multi-line input auto-grows with content (then scrolls internally at the cap) instead of staying one line.
Added a safety cap on goal plan explorer subtasks to prevent runaway resource use.
